title: JWT Verification Configuration Consistency Audit

checks.name: AuthModule resolves and configures JWT secret at startup
Guard does not override verifier secret from process.env
JWT module and guard use same JwtService provider
No hard-coded fallback secret was added
Guard requires strict Bearer token format
Guard rejects unavailable or inactive database accounts
Guard enforces declared roles using current database role

limitations: No live NestJS application authentication request was executed.
No HTTP authentication requests were sent.
No MongoDB connection or cross-tenant test was run.
Static source checks do not prove runtime dependency injection or authentication behavior.
